units.source_text: 为了不搅乱心境，打那以后，他努力不去看报纸。

en.t: In order not to disturb his state of mind, from then on he made an effort not to look at the newspaper.

units.source_text: 忍耐了一个星期，他就开始不太想再读报了。

en.t: After enduring it for a week, he began to feel less and less like reading the paper anymore.

units.source_text: 一个月以后，他甚至常常忘记还有报纸那玩意儿的存在。

en.t: After a month, he would often even forget that such a thing as a newspaper existed.

units.source_text: 以前，他看到过一张叫做“孤独地狱”的铜版画，曾经觉得很不可思议。

en.t: Once before, he had seen an engraving called "The Hell of Loneliness," and had found it deeply mysterious.

units.source_text: 一个男人以不安定的姿势飘浮在天空中，由于恐怖，连眼睛都僵硬起来。

en.t: A man floated in the sky in an unstable posture, and from terror even his eyes had gone rigid.

units.source_text: 围绕在男人周围的空间，决不是虚无的，

en.t: The space surrounding the man was by no means empty nothingness,

units.source_text: 相反满满地充斥着些半透明的死人影子，

en.t: but on the contrary was packed full of the half-transparent shadows of the dead,
so that he could not even turn his body.

units.source_text: 死人们脸上挂着各种表情，

en.t: The dead wore all kinds of expressions on their faces,

units.source_text: 都想挤掉其他人，没完没了地和男人说话。

en.t: each trying to push the others aside as they talked to the man without end.

units.source_text: 到底为什么要叫做“孤独地狱”呢？

en.t: Why on earth was it called "The Hell of Loneliness"?

units.source_text: 当时他曾觉得该不会是标题搞错了吧？

en.t: At the time, he had wondered whether the title might have been a mistake.

units.source_text: 现在总算搞清楚了，能够理解了。

en.t: Now at last it had become clear, and he could understand it.

units.source_text: 所谓孤独，就是追求幻想而得不到满足的饥渴。

en.t: Loneliness, so called, was the thirst of pursuing illusions and never being satisfied.
